issue.title: Unable to control servo using MAVSDK - set_actuator, MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ACTUATOR, MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO not working

comments.body:
small update on above,
as per https://docs.px4.io/main/en/payloads/generic_actuator_control , it works for the below code,(note: but it only works after arming, not in disarmed)

```
        mavlink_message_t msg;
        mavlink_msg_command_long_pack(
            passthrough->get_our_sysid(),
            passthrough->get_our_compid(),
            &msg,
            passthrough->get_target_sysid(),
            passthrough->get_target_compid(),
            MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ACTUATOR,
            0,                // Confirmation
            n_1,    // param1 = servo number
            0,        // param2 = PWM value
            0, 0, 0, 0, 0    // unused params
        );
        auto result2 = passthrough->send_message(msg);
```
But, if the PWM_AUX_FUNC1 is in RC AUX 1 instead of PERIPHERAL VIA ACTUATOR SET 1, above code is not working.

Is there anyway to send raw pwm value to AUX OUT port of the autopilot, even if it is configures as RC AUX1 and works for both armed and disarmed state?

Thanks in advance.

Yes, it worked. 
But is there a anyway to make it work like even in before or after arming?
Is there any other way possible to control it via mavsdk?

Even by assigning AUX PORT 1 as PERIPHERAL VIA ACTUATOR SET 1 or RC AUX 1(for manual triggering) which works after armed. Is there anyway or method to control the servo connected to AUX PORT 1 via mavsdk even in before or after arming.

I am using cube orange plus AP with px4 v1.15.5.

Thanks...
That's up to PX4, not much MAVSDK can do.

Thanks you for the same, one more question is that, 
i am using RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE (70) message  to control that particular channel PWM value via mavsdk's mavlink passthrough. But i dont know that the pwm values are changing or not, as i have connected a servo and configured as " RC AUX 1" and "RC_MAP_AUX1" as channel 8. 

`        mavlink_msg_rc_channels_override_pack(
            passthrough->get_our_sysid(),
            passthrough->get_our_compid(),
            &msg_,
            passthrough->get_target_sysid(),
            passthrough->get_target_compid(),
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch1 - ignore
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch2 - ignore
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch3 - ignore
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch4 - ignore
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch5 - ignore
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch6 - ignore
            UINT16_MAX,  // ch7 - ignore
            1500.0,       // ch8 - override only this!
            UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX,
            UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX,
            UINT16_MAX, UINT16_MAX
        );
        passthrough->send_message(msg_);`

i an using the above code. but nothing worked.

`RC_CHANNELS_RAW received:  chan1=1494 chan2=1494 chan3=982 chan4=1495 chan5=2006 chan6=982 chan7=1494 chan8=982 rssi=5
`

above is the output. as seen, the channal 8 value is not changed to the desired value(1500.0).
Is there anything i am missing?

sorry that i do not that i am asking in correct repo or not? 
thanks

I'm not aware that PX4 would use RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE.

To set an Aux1 channel, you would do that with MANUAL_CONTROL.aux1, however that's not yet implemented for MAVSDK:
https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/cpp/api_reference/classmavsdk_1_1_manual_control.html#classmavsdk_1_1_manual_control_1a1b4b34db391d7238e33b821614fc1f29

We should probably add it.

FLY by - PX4 generally won't let you move potentially dangerous actuators when you are disarmed. There is another state "prearmed" when you can move low danger control surfaces such as flaps etc. I don't know, but it might be that actuators are also not restricted in this mode.
Might be worth trying https://docs.px4.io/main/en/advanced_config/prearm_arm_disarm
Closing this as what's left is a PX4 issue, pretty sure.
